schema_status.note: Task-scoped owner evidence manifest for a delivery-governance repair in the task PR helpers. This is not a product-level loop manifest: the task changes git helper decision logic and its own regression suite, and claims no hosted activation, deployment, or capital authority.

task.title: Gate task auto-merge on exact independent review when required

scope.owned_layer: Canonical review-before-merge gate for task/<TASK-ID> PRs: policy resolution from the canonical task row and case-preserving task archive, structural binding of an approval to the exact reviewed PR number, head sha and expected base, and fail-closed merge authority/revocation readback in task_finalize.sh, safe_pr.sh, and auto_integrator.py.
scope.not_changing: No .orchestrator/config.json edit, no change to the review_approved transition itself or its guards in ai_status.py (command_approve additionally records the reviewed PR identity and warns when it is absent; it still refuses nothing it previously allowed), no hand-edited task board, no branch protection change, and no change to the publish/promote or hotfix PR paths, which are not task PRs and do not call these helpers.

observed_failures.summary: PR #4212 (task/SUP-WORKER-TRUTH-RECONCILE-001) opened 2026-07-26T20:02:43Z and merged 2026-07-26T20:04:01Z with reviewDecision empty while the canonical task was in_progress; the independent rejection arrived at 2026-07-26T20:12:48Z, after the merge.
observed_failures.root_cause: task_finalize.sh and safe_pr.sh ran `gh pr merge --auto --merge` unconditionally at PR-open time, and dev branch protection requires 0 approvals, so CI green was the only remaining gate.

observed_failures.summary: PRs #4213 and #4214 (task/OPS-L12-TELEMETRY-LINEAGE-TEST-ISOLATION-001) merged at 2026-07-26T20:18:15Z and 2026-07-26T20:22:27Z with no review_approved audit record for the task and the canonical row still in_progress.
observed_failures.root_cause: Same unconditional auto-merge path; the owner's own progress note at 20:25:10Z records 'merged to dev; awaiting Antigravity review'.

observed_failures.summary: auto_integrator.py selected review_approved tasks but never checked which reviewer approved, which head they approved, or whether the approval was still live.
observed_failures.root_cause: integrate_candidate went straight from PR eligibility and CI rollup to `gh pr merge`, with no binding between the canonical approval and the PR head oid.

observed_failures.summary: auto_integrator.py could rebase a task branch, force-push the new head, and enable auto-merge on a head no reviewer had seen.
observed_failures.root_cause: run_rebase_smoke pushed with --force-with-lease whenever the rebase changed the branch, then called merge_command(auto=True).

observed_failures.summary: Two open PRs on one task branch resolved to the first row returned by GitHub.
observed_failures.root_cause: fetch_pr_for_task took listing[0] without checking for ambiguity, so a second open PR could supply a different head than the approved one.

observed_failures.summary: PR #4217 (task/OPS-CI-PR-TRAILER-RANGE-001) merged at 2026-07-26T21:43:27Z as 71aea154b8a1ab6e652e02018f47c57f26513de0 with autoMergeRequest=null, reviews=[], mergedBy ajoe734, while the canonical task was in_progress with reviewer Codex2.
observed_failures.root_cause: A gate that only refuses `--auto` leaves the plain `gh pr merge` entry point open. Merge authority has to be denied from canonical task state, independently of which GitHub call performs the merge.

observed_failures.summary: PR #4222 (task/OPS-L12-TELEMETRY-DISCOVERY-IMPORT-001) enabled auto-merge at 2026-07-26T21:54:25Z and merged 67 seconds later at 21:55:32Z with reviews=[]; reviewer Codex2 rejected the merged tree at 22:15:44Z, twenty minutes after it landed.
observed_failures.live_source: gh pr view 4222 --json autoMergeRequest,mergedAt,mergeCommit,reviews; /home/lupin/pantheon/ai-activity-log.jsonl OPS-L12-TELEMETRY-DISCOVERY-IMPORT-001 slice (reopen at 22:15:44Z)
observed_failures.root_cause: Enabling auto-merge is itself the grant of merge authority. Deferring the check to merge time leaves GitHub holding an unconditional promise to merge.

observed_failures.summary: PR #4225 (same task) had auto-merge enabled at 2026-07-26T22:42:46Z on head 3c2d883700afc3e92568a013bb8e11ec8539031b while the canonical task was in_progress and unapproved. Human/Ops disabled it by hand before checks completed.
observed_failures.root_cause: Same as OF7; the only reason no unauthorized merge occurred is that a human intervened inside the CI window.

observed_failures.summary: The OF8 attempt escalated: PR #4225 head 3c2d883700afc3e92568a013bb8e11ec8539031b merged at 2026-07-26T23:01:39Z as 8d1b5077996a2d27aafb83ff5756f0290d0e90bc, mergedBy ajoe734, autoMergeRequest=null, reviews=[], while Human/Ops exact-head do-not-merge notes stood at 22:43:10Z and 22:52:13Z.
observed_failures.root_cause: All Pantheon agents share one GitHub account, so GitHub-side identity cannot distinguish owner from reviewer. Only canonical task state can, and an explicit do-not-merge instruction in the audit was not treated as revoking an approval.

observed_failures.summary: PR #4227 (task/SUP-COMMAND-RUNTIME-REFRESH-001) enabled auto-merge at 2026-07-26T23:10:54Z; the head then moved to 5fb21c80ba21fcdfd9f304d66b57f56362f9dc60 committed at 23:13:21Z, and GitHub merged that newer head at 23:14:41Z as e376955ff8ac3555871932457865ed1fd0beee83 with reviews=[] and the canonical task still in_progress.
observed_failures.root_cause: An auto-merge request survives a head change. Merge authority granted for one commit was still armed when a different commit became the head, so the delivery that landed was never the delivery the request described. The payload was Stage-1 docs/evidence with the live swap still blocked, which does not waive review-before-merge.

observed_failures.summary: PR #4226 (task/OPS-L12-TELEMETRY-DISCOVERY-IMPORT-001) enabled auto-merge at 2026-07-26T23:06:04Z on head 4628dc721b0e1b434303fac679c01a9afa05b108 and merged at 23:07:09Z as 1cf27337e9197c8bc0840e466f55019065e3576e with reviewDecision empty and reviews=[]. It was the third unreviewed merge on that one task branch after #4222 and #4225.
observed_failures.root_cause: Same unconditional auto-merge grant. Nothing about a task branch that has already merged unreviewed twice changed the third attempt's outcome, which is what a gate derived from canonical state rather than PR history has to fix.

observed_failures.summary: PR #4230 (task/OPS-CI-PR-TRAILER-RANGE-001) enabled auto-merge at 2026-07-26T23:33:20Z on head 1bb2b839bad3258d7c5fe353e957e6a5fec08545 and merged at 23:34:22Z as 643181a067ec5c344faac0766c69de0d5cfb32eb with every required check green, reviewDecision empty, reviews=[], latestReviews=[], mergedBy ajoe734, while the canonical task was in_progress with reviewer Codex2 since 23:28:46Z.
observed_failures.root_cause: Green CI was the only thing standing between the push and the merge. CI proves the delivery builds; it is not the independent canonical review the task contract requires, and no GitHub-side signal on a single shared account can supply that.

observed_failures.summary: Open PR #4201 (task/P0-TW-PAPER-ACTIVATE-001, owner Antigravity, reviewer Claude) still had auto-merge armed on head dc5d7128bad1717b23b6c750076b0cb47a213ae3 with reviewDecision empty and reviews=[] while the canonical task was in_progress. Only mergeStateStatus=BEHIND kept it from merging; Human/Ops disabled auto-merge without touching the branch.
observed_failures.root_cause: The first pass revoked a standing auto-merge request only on the blocked path, and on the approved path only just before the merge call. A gated PR that resolves to waiting - which is exactly what BEHIND produces - kept its request. A stale base is not a safety property: it expires the moment the base catches up.

observed_failures.summary: The gate lowercased archived task filenames even though the canonical archive writer preserves task-id case. On the production filesystem ai-task-archive/tasks/LUV-REACTIVATE-KW01-001.json existed while the gate returned source=missing.
observed_failures.live_source: Codex2 independent review of PR #4218 head 5a9ad1643eba2580bf8a51c71a6f3a43ad8c57b6; ai-task-archive/tasks/LUV-REACTIVATE-KW01-001.json
observed_failures.root_cause: load_task_contract built `<task-id.lower()>.json` instead of the archive writer's case-preserving, percent-escaped filename.

observed_failures.summary: task_finalize.sh and safe_pr.sh swallowed `gh pr merge --disable-auto` failure and then printed that auto-merge was off. A standing autoMergeRequest could remain armed after either helper returned success.
observed_failures.live_source: Codex2 independent review of PR #4218 head 5a9ad1643eba2580bf8a51c71a6f3a43ad8c57b6; helper lines formerly ending in `|| true`
observed_failures.root_cause: Neither helper read autoMergeRequest before or after revocation, so it could not distinguish already-off from failed-and-still-armed state.

merge_entry_point_coverage.control: asks the gate before PR creation; a gated task PR is opened without the auto-merge label; the helper reads autoMergeRequest, revokes only a standing request, reads it back, and exits nonzero if GitHub is unreadable or the request remains armed

same gate call before `gh pr merge --auto --merge`; the gated path distinguishes already-off from armed, verifies state after revocation, and aborts when a failed revoke leaves autoMergeRequest present

gate runs before the CI and merge-state probes; a gated PR merges only with --match-head-commit <approved-oid> and never with --auto; after every attempted revocation the integrator reads live autoMergeRequest and blocks before any merge call when that read is unavailable or still armed, regardless of the disable command exit status

merge_entry_point_coverage.entry_point: auto-merge creation (`gh pr merge --auto`, GitHub UI, or API)
merge_entry_point_coverage.control: allow_auto_merge is False for every gated task in every state, including an approved exact head; revoke_auto_merge is set whenever a request is standing

merge_entry_point_coverage.entry_point: an auto-merge request already standing on a gated PR
merge_entry_point_coverage.control: the integrator revokes it immediately after the gate decision, before the CI and merge-state probes, so a PR that resolves to blocked or waiting cannot keep it; a BEHIND base is not treated as protection
a request enabled before the current head is refused outright, so GitHub cannot land a head the request never covered

merge_entry_point_coverage.entry_point: direct `gh pr merge` / GitHub merge API by the shared credential
merge_entry_point_coverage.control: the decision reads no PR-side identity, review, or check state, so the same account that authors, approves and merges cannot satisfy the gate
merge_entry_point_coverage.limitation: A human or agent holding the GitHub credential can still press merge outside every Pantheon helper. The gate cannot prevent that; it denies merge authority to all repository tooling and makes the resulting state auditable. Preventing it entirely needs branch protection to require a review, which is outside this task's no-config-edit scope.

merge_entry_point_coverage.entry_point: an approved head replaced on the PR before the merge
merge_entry_point_coverage.control: the approval carries the reviewed PR number, head sha and expected base, and the gate compares each exactly; a replacement head is refused whether it is newer or older than the approval, and an approval with no binding cannot open the gate at all

acceptance.statement: Canonical task marked review-before-merge never enables or performs merge before exact assigned reviewer approval.
Approval is structurally bound to the exact task PR head, PR number, expected base, reviewer identity, and a non-stale timestamp, and the gate compares those identities exactly.

acceptance.statement: Reviewer rejection, head change, head replacement with an older commit, missing state, GitHub ambiguity, a failed or unverified auto-merge revocation, and concurrent finalize all fail closed.

command_runtime_bootstrap.description: At the latest revalidation the governed supervisor command runtime was 6692d51c9bc5a48ffcbaac8cf817b635351a7c9a and did not yet contain REVIEW_PR / REVIEW_HEAD_SHA review_binding support. The repository change therefore proves the new gate but does not by itself prove that the installed command runtime has switched to it.
command_runtime_bootstrap.containment: Keep PR #4218 auto-merge disabled, obtain Codex2 review against the exact pushed head, merge only that head, and treat installed-runtime activation as unproven until the normal command-runtime refresh reports a merged SHA containing this change. This bootstrap boundary cannot unlock an unreviewed merge; it only prevents a live-activation claim.
command_runtime_bootstrap.recheck_trigger: PANTHEON_COMMAND_RUNTIME_SHA does not contain scripts/ai_status.py review_binding support after PR #4218 merges.

integrator_dependency.description: A gated PR no longer merges by itself. After approval the merge comes from `python3 scripts/git/auto_integrator.py --execute --task-id <TASK-ID>`, run by cron or directly. If that lane is not running, approved PRs stay open instead of merging.
integrator_dependency.containment: This is the intended fail-closed direction: an unmerged approved PR is recoverable, a merged unreviewed commit is not. Both helpers print the exact follow-up command, and chair review already flags task PRs open past 24 h.
integrator_dependency.recheck_trigger: An approved task PR open for more than one auto-integrator interval.

audit_rotation.description: The approval record is read from the active activity audit plus its rotated .gz archives. If both were lost, the gate would report approval_record_missing and block.
audit_rotation.containment: Fail closed; recovery is a fresh reviewer approval.
audit_rotation.recheck_trigger: A gated merge blocked with approval_record_missing on a task whose row is review_approved.

assign_treated_as_revocation.description: An `assign` event after an approval revokes it even when owner and reviewer are unchanged.
assign_treated_as_revocation.containment: Deliberate: the 2026-07-26 timeline includes a post-merge reviewer rebinding. Recovery is one reviewer re-approval.
assign_treated_as_revocation.recheck_trigger: Repeated approval_revoked blocks caused by no-op reassignments.

do_not_merge_note_matching.description: A `note` event whose message contains do not merge, changes required, rejects, rejected, or revert now revokes a standing approval. The match is on message text, so an unrelated note that quotes one of those phrases will also revoke.
do_not_merge_note_matching.containment: The signal only ever blocks; it can never unlock a merge. A false positive costs one reviewer re-approval, which is the same recovery as any other revocation. It exists because the #4225 and #4222 do-not-merge instructions were recorded as notes rather than as reopen or blocker events.
do_not_merge_note_matching.recheck_trigger: approval_revoked with revocation_type note:do_not_merge on a task whose reviewer did not intend to reject.

auto_merge_request_revocation.description: A gated PR now has any standing auto-merge request revoked before the exact-head merge, and an approved head is refused outright when the request predates it. The integrator and both PR-opening helpers verify the grant is absent; an unreadable or still-armed state blocks.
auto_merge_request_revocation.containment: Already-off is a no-op. A standing request is revoked and read back. A failed command is tolerated only if the readback proves another actor already turned it off; any request still present aborts the helper or integrator.
auto_merge_request_revocation.recheck_trigger: A helper or integrator reports that autoMergeRequest remains armed after revocation.

canonical_state_trust.description: The gate trusts the governed status wrapper and its audit rather than GitHub reviewDecision, because Pantheon reviewers approve through scripts/ai-status.sh and all task PRs share one GitHub author.
canonical_state_trust.containment: ai_status.py already binds the command root, runtime SHA, and remote before any canonical write.
canonical_state_trust.recheck_trigger: If task PRs ever gain per-agent GitHub identities, add GitHub review evidence as a second binding.

legacy_unbound_approvals.description: Approvals recorded before this change carry no review_binding, so a gated PR whose only approval predates the cutover blocks with approval_head_binding_missing.
legacy_unbound_approvals.containment: Fails in the safe direction. Recovery is one re-approval naming the head; task_finalize.sh and safe_pr.sh print the complete command. command_approve warns at approval time rather than refusing, so a task with no PR is unaffected.
legacy_unbound_approvals.recheck_trigger: A gated merge blocked with approval_head_binding_missing on a review_approved task.

failed_revocation_stalls_a_green_pr.description: When `gh pr merge --disable-auto` fails for an environmental reason, the live readback is unavailable, or the request remains armed despite a zero exit, an approved and green gated PR blocks instead of merging.
failed_revocation_stalls_a_green_pr.containment: Deliberate: the alternative is merging while a grant that could not be proved withdrawn is still armed. A nonzero command may continue only when readback proves another actor already turned the request off; otherwise the blocked result names the manual revocation and re-run.
